svg.title: Blue Curve V
svg.desc: Interpretive study after a visually inspected primary museum photograph. Approximate geometry; standardized vivid screen colours. White rectangular painted ground retained: the photograph shows a straight outer canvas edge and shadow around the white lower-right area. The blue interior curve is approximated; photographic perspective rectified.
svg.metadata: Reference: https://www.thebroad.org/art/ellsworth-kelly/blue-curve-v; object B-KELLY-2P76.05; reviewed 2026-10-27; not a facsimile.
